name: GameScorekeeper
what_it_is: An esports data API and white-label product provider for media, fantasy and betting clients.
pricing: Pricing is not published; data packages are sold through contact.
notable: Founded 2016 and based in Aarhus, Denmark.

facts.fact: GameScorekeeper says it was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Aarhus, Denmark.
The homepage cites more than 75,000 matches, 6,000 tournaments, 45,000 teams and 80,000 players tracked per year.
The coverage page lists Counter-Strike 2, League of Legends, Dota 2, Call of Duty, Honor of Kings, Arena of Valor, Mobile Legends, Wild Rift, Rainbow Six Siege, Valorant, Overwatch and Rocket League.
The public API documentation lists sports, competitions, stages and fixtures endpoints plus LoL champion, Dota 2 hero and CS2 map lookups.

name: OddsMatrix
what_it_is: A betting data feed and API from EveryMatrix covering odds, scores and settlement for sports and 20+ esports titles.
platforms: Pull API over HTTP and push API over TCP socket
pricing: Pricing is not published; the vendor offers a one-month free trial and agrees packaging with each client.
notable: The site says it is powered by EveryMatrix and serves more than 40 sportsbooks.

facts.fact: OddsMatrix says it delivers real-time betting odds, scores and settlements for sports and esports with a one-month free trial.
The vendor says it covers 75+ sports and 20+ esports titles, including six based on traditional sports such as FIFA and NBA2k.
The FAQ says clients agree on packaging, request a trial account and connect through PULL (HTTP) and PUSH (TCP socket) APIs.
The about page says OddsMatrix is powered by EveryMatrix.
